enrichment.summary: This change order removes ventilation work at McClymonds High, Roosevelt Middle, Ralph Bunche High and the Gateway to Laney College campus, giving the district a credit. The contract price drops from $12,040,995.00 to $11,720,359.50, based on preliminary change orders (PCOs) 1 through 4. All other terms stay the same.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

enrichment.headline: Adds lead-in-water planning and 150 more days for Perkins Eastman at no added cost
enrichment.summary: Perkins Eastman Architects will add work to help the district build a districtwide plan for testing, reducing and managing lead in water, including three strategy options with school-level cost estimates. The contract end date moves from December 31, 2025 to May 30, 2026 (150 more days). The cost stays at $1,352,835.00.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

enrichment.summary: ACC Environmental Consultants will take soil samples, run soil tests and write a report to identify hazardous materials during construction of a new classroom building at the MLA at Maxwell Park campus. The added amount includes a $3,096.00 contingency. The contract limit rises from $24,442.50 to $58,502.50.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

enrichment.headline: Adds $205,307.00 for a temporary generator to protect the district's data center
enrichment.summary: Tulum Innovative Engineering will provide a temporary generator for the Cole data center, which the Information Technology Department says is needed to keep operating in a power outage because the server supports about half of the district's network and internet services. The contract total rises from $43,353.44 to $248,660.44, and the end date moves 30 days, to January 30, 2026.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

enrichment.headline: Awards DecoTech $101,100.00 to install security cameras at Santa Fe Elementary
enrichment.summary: DecoTech Systems will install about 21 new security cameras, troubleshoot about 7 existing ones, supply about 7 spare cameras and replace the recording server at Santa Fe Elementary School. The amount includes a $9,000.00 contingency, and DecoTech was the lowest responsive bidder. Work is expected from January 15 to April 15, 2026.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

enrichment.summary: Ninyo & Moore will prepare and carry out a preliminary endangerment assessment (PEA) work plan for the Coliseum College Preparatory Academy site expansion, including 38 soil borings, 6 groundwater borings and 6 soil gas wells.
